record.paper_title: Open Problems in Partial Differential Equations Arising from Fluid Dynamics
record.original_question: For the general nonlinear Boltzmann equation, do there exist global large-amplitude smooth solutions, beyond perturbative or near-equilibrium regimes?

evidence.quote: Other related questions, such as global existence of large amplitude smooth solution to the general nonlinear Boltzmann equation [3], ... are waiting to be attacked too.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the nonlinear Boltzmann equation
\[
\partial_t F + v\cdot\nabla_x F = Q(F,F),\qquad t>0,\; x\in\mathbb{R}^3\;(\text{or }\mathbb{T}^3),\; v\in\mathbb{R}^3,
\]
with initial data $F(0,x,v)=F_0(x,v)\geq 0$, where the collision operator is
\[
Q(F,G)(v) = \int_{\mathbb{R}^3}\int_{\mathbb{S}^2} B(v-u,\omega)\bigl[F(v')G(u') - F(v)G(u)\bigr]\,d\omega\,du,
\]
with post-collisional velocities $v' = v - ((v-u)\cdot\omega)\omega$, $u' = u + ((v-u)\cdot\omega)\omega$, and a physical collision kernel $B(v-u,\omega)$ (e.g.\ hard or soft potentials, with or without angular cutoff).

Question: Beyond the perturbative or near-equilibrium regime — that is, without assuming that $F_0$ is close in any small norm to a global Maxwellian $\mu(v)=(2\pi)^{-3/2}e^{-|v|^2/2}$ — do there exist global-in-time smooth (classical) solutions $F(t,x,v)\geq 0$ to the above Cauchy problem for general large-amplitude initial data $F_0$?
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made on global well-posedness for the Boltzmann equation with large-amplitude initial data: Duan–Huang–Wang–Yang (2017) and subsequent works established global existence and uniqueness of mild solutions in the whole space, torus, and bounded domains under bounded velocity-weighted L∞ norms with smallness only of certain L¹_x L∞_v norms and defect mass/energy/entropy, allowing large-amplitude oscillations. However, the question of global classical/smooth large-amplitude solutions in full generality (e.g. without cutoff smallness conditions, in general bounded domains, and beyond mild-solution frameworks) remains open.

status_evidence.title: Global Well-Posedness of the Boltzmann Equation with Large Amplitude Initial Data
status_evidence.snippet: Global existence and uniqueness of mild solutions to the Boltzmann equation in the whole space or torus for a class of initial data... allowing large-amplitude oscillations.
status_evidence.claim: Large-amplitude global mild solutions established under specific smallness assumptions on auxiliary norms, partially resolving the question.

status_evidence.title: The Boltzmann equation with large-amplitude initial data in bounded domains
status_evidence.snippet: Global solutions around global Maxwellians on bounded domains with diffuse reflection, allowing arbitrary large amplitude and vacuum.
status_evidence.claim: Extension to bounded domains with diffuse-reflection boundary, but still around Maxwellian framework.

status_evidence.title: The large amplitude solution of the Boltzmann equation with soft potential
status_evidence.snippet: Large amplitude solution for soft potentials.
status_evidence.claim: Further extensions to soft potentials, indicating ongoing partial progress.
